newsitem.title: USA: Lomak sells $55 mln convertible debentures.
newsitem.headline: Lomak sells $55 mln convertible debentures.

text.p: Lomak Petroleum Inc said Friday that it sold in a private offering $55 million of six percent convertible subordinated debentures due 2007.
Lomak said the debentures are convertible into common stock at $19.25 per share, representing a 24.2 percent premium over Thursday's closing price.
The debentures are redeemable at Lomak's option on February 1, 2000, or later at prices beginning at 104 percent, Lomak said.

The oil and gas concern said it will use proceeds to repay a portion of its bank borrowings and that it would use its resulting increased borrowing capacity under its bank credit facility to fund future acquisitions and drilling activities.
